current_scope.purpose: Public minimized node registry for R&D documentation, HBCE Platform node references, JOKER-C2 runtime references, Registry / Verify node references, IPR AI Audit Trail visibility, registry v3 testing, technical review, fail-closed verification behavior and public proof-reference continuity.
current_scope.public_position: This registry is a public R&D reference surface. It is not a public authority registry, not a regulated certification register, not an eIDAS qualified trust service, not a regulated KYC/AML provider, not a custodial identity service, not a territorial deployment map and not a production compliance framework by itself.
current_scope.operational_boundary: Node entries are descriptive public metadata. They do not expose private endpoints, internal topology, production credentials, secrets, privileged infrastructure access, client payloads, tax codes, national identifiers, document numbers, identity documents, private evidence, regulated identity data or production operational certainty.

HBCE_PLATFORM_NODE.interpretation: Public R&D node reference for HBCE Platform. It does not represent production deployment, public authority approval or infrastructure certification.

JOKER_C2_RUNTIME_NODE.interpretation: Public R&D runtime node reference for JOKER-C2. It does not create production runtime authorization or autonomous command authority.

REGISTRY_VERIFY_NODE.interpretation: Public R&D node reference for registry and verification surfaces. It does not create legal certification or compliance certification.

IPR_AI_AUDIT_TRAIL_NODE.interpretation: Public R&D node reference for the IPR AI Audit Trail MVP. It remains pilot-positioned and non-production by itself.

rules.public_node_interpretation: A public node entry is descriptive R&D registry metadata unless independently supported by a canonical proof record. It does not certify production readiness, territorial deployment, public authority approval, regulated compliance, cybersecurity assurance, legal identity, KYC/AML compliance, eIDAS qualification, institutional mandate or JOKER-C2 access.
rules.production_interpretation: RND_ACTIVE and PILOT_ACTIVE statuses must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, public infrastructure deployment, legal identity validation, JOKER-C2 runtime authorization or institutional mandate.

privacy_note: This public node registry must not store private endpoints, credentials, secrets, private keys, production logs, internal network details, sensitive infrastructure topology, tax codes, national identifiers, document numbers, identity documents, identity scans, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, personal data, client files, regulated identity documents or non-public operational payloads. Public node records should use minimized labels and high-level technical metadata only.
empty_registry_interpretation: An empty nodes array means no public node records are currently available in this registry file. It does not certify infrastructure inactivity, security status, production status, territorial coverage, operational deployment, institutional adoption or compliance status by itself.

constraints.node_id: Public minimal node identifier only; must not expose internal hostnames, private IPs, secrets, endpoints, document numbers, identity data or sensitive topology.
constraints.node_type: HBCE_PLATFORM_NODE | JOKER_C2_RUNTIME_NODE | REGISTRY_VERIFY_NODE | IPR_AI_AUDIT_TRAIL_NODE | RND_NODE | LOCAL_PILOT_NODE | ENTERPRISE_PILOT_NODE | STATIC_VERIFICATION_NODE | REGISTRY_REFERENCE_NODE | AUDIT_TRAIL_NODE | IPR_VERIFICATION_REFERENCE_NODE
constraints.ipr_card_id: Optional public IPR Card reference only.
constraints.verification_level: L0 | L1 | L2 | L3 | IPR_BASE_NOT_VERIFIED | IPR_VERIFIED_PRIVATE_CHECK | IPR_PROFESSIONAL_PILOT | RND_ONLY | NOT_APPLICABLE
constraints.timestamp: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 parseable timestamp with timezone when available
constraints.status: RND_ACTIVE | PILOT_ACTIVE | INACTIVE | SUSPENDED | DEPRECATED | LEGACY_REFERENCE | PLANNED | RETAINED

verification.rule: Public node entries must be treated as descriptive R&D registry metadata unless independently verified by a canonical proof record.
verification.fail_closed_rule: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, placeholder-based, forbidden-field-based or inconsistent node registry state must not produce operational certainty.
verification.production_rule: RND_ACTIVE and PILOT_ACTIVE statuses must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, public infrastructure deployment, territorial coverage, JOKER-C2 runtime authorization, legal identity validation or institutional mandate.
